description: List accessibility rules from both engines — axe-core (104) and the WebAbility detectors (90+) — with optional filters. Every rule carries `fixability` (mechanical | contextual | visual) and a `fix` op template, so you can pick the rules worth auto-fixing before scanning. Returns ruleId, engine, description, help, helpUrl, tags/wcag, fixability, fix.

engine.description: Which engine's rules to list (default all)

fixability.description: Only rules of this fixability tier

rule.description: Only rules whose id contains these whole words (e.g. "link" → link-name, skip-link, not blink; "color-contrast"; case and -/_ insensitive). Also accepted: ruleId, id, query.

tags.description: axe tag filter (e.g. ["wcag2aa"], ["best-practice"], ["cat.aria"]; a category also works without "cat."). WebAbility rules match on their WCAG criterion tag (e.g. "wcag143"). An unknown tag or category is an error that lists the valid ones.

name: get_rules
title: List accessibility rules
